objects.description: Close expired pauses, then POST the due "ends soon" and "back on" messages; mark them only on a 2xx reply.

  cron      'job_pause_sweep' */5 * * * * on live at 2026-10-23; target * * * * * in step 6
sections.GOTCHAS:
The 24-hour window on ANNOUNCE stops a backlog of stale "you're back on" messages after a long outage.
ORDELO_APP_URL is shared by test and local runs (see the restaurant plan's known limits): point it at the
  instance that should send the messages.
sections.HOW IT FITS:
ADR 0013. The sweep never decides availability (is_paused() does, from the clock); it only:
  1. CLOSE:   open rows whose ends_at passed -> ended_at = ends_at, end_reason = 'expired' (bookkeeping only).
  2. REMIND:  open rows ending within PAUSE_REMIND_BEFORE_MINS, not yet reminded   -> payload "ending_soon".
  3. ANNOUNCE: rows closed as 'expired' in the last 24 h whose announced_at is NULL  -> payload "ended".
  4. POST {event_type: 'pause_sweep', ending_soon: [...], ended: [...]} to /pause-hooks/sweep; on 2xx set
     reminded_at / announced_at for exactly the pause_ids handed to the app. A failed POST leaves them for the next
     scheduled run. A later background send failure is logged but not retried; availability remains clock-derived.
  Each item: {pause_id, audience, principal, scope, ends_at}. The app routes by audience: 'rider' ->
  RiderMessenger.for_rider(principal) (ordelo/rider_messaging/: the rider's channel), 'rest_admin' -> the
  restaurant bot, in the admin's own chats for that restaurant (t_admin_pause_chats(), telegram/t_admin_pauses.sql).
  Python: watomation/routers/pause_hooks.py <- POST /pause-hooks/sweep (answers 200 at once and sends in the
  background, like the order-alerts route: a send that fails after the 2xx is logged, not retried).

  is_paused(audience, principal, scope) = an open row (ended_at IS NULL) with starts_at <= now() < ends_at.
  The moment ends_at passes the person is available again, with no job involved, so a late, failed or
  mis-pointed sweep can only delay a MESSAGE, never leave someone switched off.
Audiences: 'rider' (principal = rider_master.rider_id, scope NULL = all jobs) and 'rest_admin' (principal = the

  one of its admins. Two admins pausing at the same moment are serialised by an advisory lock per restaurant,

Delivery order journey (statuses in delivery_summary.status unless noted):
  1 create   /payment-hooks/payment-complete -> init_delivery() inserts the summary:
             'restaurant_unconfirmed', or 'unassigned' with a pickup time when the restaurant auto-accepts.
  2 confirm  trigger_restaurant_updates -> POST /delivery-hooks/restaurant-confirmation-request -> admins asked

             decline ('declined' is terminal); restaurant_order_set_pickup() sets pickup_time and 'unassigned'.
             process_restaurant_confirmation() (cron 10 s) marks unanswered orders 'restaurant_timedout'; Python then
             sets a default pickup time and 'unassigned'.
  3 options  process_delivery() (cron 5 s) adds delivery_detail rows, one vehicle type at a time by delivery_option rank,
             and marks the summary 'timedout' when every vehicle type timed out (trigger -> /delivery-hooks/delivery-timedout).
  4 offers   job_create_dispatch() (cron 5 s) inserts delivery_dispatch offers for available riders
             (trigger -> /delivery-hooks/delivery-dispatch -> WhatsApp offer to each rider).
  5 assign   a rider taps Accept (dispatch 'accepted'); job_assign_dispatch() (cron 5 s) gives the order to the first
             acceptance: dispatch/detail/summary 'assigned' + delivery_inflight row
             (trigger -> /delivery-hooks/delivery-inflight-graph-init starts the rider agent; other riders told they missed it).
  6 deliver  rider agent: pickup code check ('pickedup'), dispatch_cancel_before_pickup() re-offers the order,
             dispatch_complete_func() marks everything 'completed' and removes the inflight row.
  Around it: job_rider_pickup_alerts() reminders, kitchen Ready / +10 / +20 (restaurant_admin/), Telegram receipts.

sections.HOW IT FITS:
After a restaurant accepts and a rider takes the job, the kitchen gets one message (the receipt) with Ready, +10 and +20
  (plans/telegram-phase-7-8-kitchen-actions-and-notices.md, D28-D38). One rule for both channels, atomic:
    Ready: first tap per dispatch wins (ready_at / ready_by / ready_dispatch_id on delivery_summary; takeaway too).
    +N:    relative to the original pickup (pickup_time_initial); a repeat that changes nothing writes nothing. The UPDATE sets
           restaurant_confirmation_status 'restaurant_pickuptime_adjusted', so trigger_restaurant_updates POSTs and Python tells
           the rider; Ready changes no confirmation status, so no trigger fires and the follow-up is Python's.
  Gate (D31, same as ordelo/delivery_progress.check_delivery_progress): a delivery_inflight row exists and its dispatch is
  not 'pickedup' / 'completed'; takeaway: status 'pickup_confirmed'.
  Telegram receipts are t_sent_messages rows (kind 'receipt') that follow the database: a WhatsApp tap changes the receipt
  status key, job_t_receipt_refresh() (5 s) notices and every Telegram copy is edited. Plain notices (auto-accept, rider
  alerts, delivered, feedback) are recorded as kind 'notice' for audit.
  Pauses (R6): a NEW receipt or notice goes to t_alert_destinations() (telegram/t_order_alerts.sql), which leaves
  out admins who paused their alerts (/off on the restaurant bot); receipts already sent keep being refreshed and
  tapped (t_receipts_stale() still uses t_order_card_destinations()).
  Tables used: delivery_summary, takeaway_summary, delivery_inflight, delivery_dispatch, rider_master, restaurant_master,
  food_order / order_item (restaurant-agents), t_invites, t_sent_messages.
  Python: utils_common/order_management/restaurant_actions.py ready() / adjust_pickup() (WhatsApp and Telegram actors);
          channels/telegram/rest_admin/receipts/store.py ReceiptStore; channels/telegram/rest_admin/notices.py Notices;
          watomation/routers/telegram_order_alerts.py <- job_t_receipt_refresh().

  cron 'job_process_owntracks' (30 s) -> job_process_owntracks():
      location messages  -> rider_location (one row per GPS fix, linked to the rider's live order if any)
      transition events  -> rider_location_event (enter / leave a region)
                            -> trigger -> POST /location-hooks/notify-rider-location-event (customer / restaurant updates)
  The customer's live map (/location-hooks/live-location-map/{order}) reads rider_location.
  job_null_or_outdated_location() (cron, INACTIVE) would alert about live jobs whose rider sent no recent fix.
  Looks at delivery_inflight jobs whose rider's latest rider_location is missing or older than
  ordelo_config LOCATION_ENABLE_TIME_INTERVAL minutes (default 1) and POSTs them to
  /location-hooks/null-or-outdated-location, which asks the rider to switch location sharing on.

sections.HOW IT FITS:

sections.HOW IT FITS:
Telegram order cards (D12, D14, D22, D24, D26): linked admins get the order card at configured offsets after the order
  arrives; each new copy replaces the previous one in that chat; every copy follows the order until it is final.
  The database is authoritative and is checked before every send; the ledger (t_sent_messages) only remembers what to tidy.
    pg_cron every 5 s -> job_t_order_alerts()
       SEED    delivery_summary + takeaway_summary rows still 'restaurant_unconfirmed' (< 15 min old) with at least one
               destination -> one t_order_alerts checkpoint per offset (TGRAM_ORDER_ALERT_OFFSETS_SECS, '0,15,30,45')
       CANCEL  pending checkpoints of orders no longer unconfirmed
       DUE     pending checkpoints with due_at <= now(); one winner per order (the largest offset)
       STALE   up to 50 orders with copies that show an old status or a revoked viewer
       POST    ORDELO_APP_URL/telegram/rest-admin/order-alerts {reminders, refreshes}
       MARK    only on a 2xx answer: superseded first, then winners 'sent'
    -> watomation/routers/telegram_order_alerts.py (background tasks)
       OrderCards.remind() -> snapshot -> send per destination -> t_order_card_sent -> delete old copies
       OrderCards.refresh() -> snapshot -> t_order_cards_take -> edit/delete -> t_order_card_mark
  Python: channels/telegram/rest_admin/order_cards/store.py CardStore.snapshot() / card_sent() / take_for_refresh() / mark().
  Pauses (R6, ADR 0013): NEW copies go to t_alert_destinations() (linked admins minus paused ones); whether a
  chat may SEE and TAP a card stays t_order_card_destinations(), so a paused admin's existing copies keep
  being refreshed and their buttons keep working.
  Card status keys MUST match channels/telegram/rest_admin/order_cards/model.py (Status):
    awaiting | accepted | pickup_set | declined | auto_accepted | gone
